en.name: Cream liqueurs, unopened
en.summary: An unopened bottle of cream liqueur keeps 6–8 months in a cool, dark cupboard. Unlike ordinary spirits, which never spoil, a cream liqueur contains real dairy, and that is why it carries a date at all.
en.pantry: 6–8 months in a cool, dark cupboard, upright, while the bottle is sealed. The cream in the bottle is stabilised by the alcohol and by homogenisation, but it is still dairy, and dairy sets a limit that a bottle of whisky or vodka simply does not have. Heat and light are what shorten it, so keep the bottle away from the hob and off a sunny shelf, and check the producer's date on the label — it is the most reliable guide you have for that particular bottle.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for an unopened bottle, but refrigeration does no harm and is a sensible choice in a warm kitchen. Once the bottle is opened the calculation changes: it becomes a dairy product in an open container, so cap it, refrigerate it and follow the producer's instructions on the label. No opened figure is published here, so the label is what you go by.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published, and freezing a cream liqueur is a poor idea. The alcohol keeps it from freezing solid while the water and fat do separate, and what thaws is a grainy, curdled liquid that no amount of shaking rescues. Keep the bottle in the cupboard or the fridge instead.
en.thawing: Not applicable — cream liqueurs should not be frozen, and a frozen bottle usually thaws separated.
spoilage: Curdling, graininess or solid lumps when poured.
A sour, cheesy smell instead of a sweet dairy one.
A separated layer that does not come back together when shaken.
A bottle that has been stored warm and now looks noticeably darker or thicker.
tips: Check the date printed on the label; it is bottle-specific and beats any general figure.
Store upright, cool and dark, away from the cooker.
Refrigerate after opening and follow the label's guidance from then on.
A little lemon or lime in a cocktail can curdle cream liqueur in the glass — add it last, or not at all.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle of cream liqueur keep?
faq.a: 6–8 months in a cool, dark cupboard, and check the date on the label.

faq.q: Why do cream liqueurs have a date when spirits do not?
faq.a: Because they contain dairy. A high-proof spirit has nothing for microbes to live on, but cream does, so the bottle carries a real limit.

faq.q: Does cream liqueur need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Yes. Once opened it is dairy in an open container, so cap it, keep it cold and follow the producer's instructions on the label.

zh.name: 奶酒（未開瓶）
zh.summary: 未開瓶的奶酒放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 6～8 個月。和永遠不會壞的一般烈酒不同，奶酒裡有真正的乳製品，這也是它為什麼會有日期。
zh.pantry: 未開瓶、直立、放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，6～8 個月。瓶子裡的鮮奶油靠酒精與均質化穩定住，但它終究是乳製品，而乳製品會帶來一個威士忌或伏特加根本不存在的上限。縮短它的是熱和光，所以請遠離爐台、別放在有陽光的層架上，並且看瓶身上廠商標示的日期——對那一瓶來說，那是你手上最可靠的依據。
zh.fridge: 未開瓶的部分沒有公布冷藏期限，但冷藏不會有害，在溫暖的廚房裡也是合理選擇。一旦開瓶，情況就不同了：它變成裝在開口容器裡的乳製品，請蓋緊、冷藏，並依照標籤上廠商的指示。這裡沒有公布開瓶後的數字，所以請以標籤為準。
zh.freezer: 沒有冷凍的期限數據，而且冷凍奶酒不是個好主意。酒精讓它不會完全凍成固體，但水和乳脂會分離，解凍後是一杯粗糙、結絮的液體，怎麼搖都回不來。請改放櫥櫃或冷藏。
zh.thawing: 不適用——奶酒不應冷凍，凍過的通常解凍後就是分離的。
spoilage: 倒出來結絮、口感粗糙，或出現固體顆粒。
聞起來酸、有起司味，而不是甜甜的奶香。
分層之後搖也搖不回來。
存放在高溫處後，顏色明顯變深或變得濃稠。
tips: 看瓶身標示的日期；那是針對這一瓶的，比任何通則都準。
直立、陰涼、避光，遠離爐台。
開瓶後冷藏，並且從此以標籤指示為準。
調酒時的檸檬或萊姆會讓奶酒在杯中結絮——最後再加，或乾脆不加。

faq.q: 未開瓶的奶酒可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃 6～8 個月，並請確認瓶身上的日期。

faq.q: 為什麼烈酒沒有期限，奶酒卻有？
faq.a: 因為它含乳製品。高酒精度的烈酒沒有東西能讓微生物存活，但鮮奶油有，所以這瓶酒有實質的上限。
要。開瓶後它就是裝在開口容器裡的乳製品，請蓋緊、冷藏，並依標籤上廠商的指示。
